sources.title: Borealis six e-scooter curb-crash Hybrid III head and neck measurements
sources.publisher: Borealis / Bailly, Schauble, Guesneau, Wei and Petit
sources.relevance: Six Hybrid III sled crashes with/without bicycle helmet; head linear and rotational accelerations and upper-neck forces/moments. Public individual CSV listed, repository license CC BY 4.0; file-level rights and calibration remain unverified. E-scooter conditions are not football helmet impacts.

sources.title: EPFL controlled hockey helmet IMUs and Hybrid III headform kinematics
sources.relevance: Three helmet-mounted IMUs and instrumented Hybrid III headform reference during hockey impacts; possible sensor-coupling benchmark. Files are restricted, permission required; access and rights remain unverified.

sources.title: Virginia Tech Cranium Resonance Index experimental headform vibration note
sources.relevance: Experimental high-frequency head/headform vibration metric and filter choices; not a finalized injury criterion, no raw per-trial independent football validation data verified. Methodology reference only.
